3 And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure. (1 John 3:3 KJV)

John is telling us that every person that has the hope of being resurrected to be like Jesus at His Second Coming will purify himself, even as Jesus is pure. This verse is saying that if you have been born again, and have the Spirit of Jesus living in you, and have hope of getting your glorified body when Jesus comes again, then you will purify yourself. If a person thinks they have been saved and born again, and yet continues to live an ungodly life, then this is saying that they truly weren’t born again. All who have the born again Spirit should want to live a holy life (1 Peter 1:15), not to obtain anything from God, but because of our love for God, and what He has done by saving us.

I can’t imagine how anyone could truly be born again, and not want to live for God, but live like the devil. When you are born again, and your old self that was corrupt from birth, is replaced with Jesus Spirit (Galatians 4:6), how can it not change your desires to follow Jesus instead of the devil. I am afraid that many people, who think they are Christians, were never really born again and saved. Be sure you are saved, as we only have this life to accept Jesus as our Savior. Everyone will bow the knee to Jesus (Romans 14:11), but if it is only after His return, then you can’t be saved. The time is NOW, to accept Him as your Lord and Savior. Be sure you have done so TODAY!
